ata.title: Centre Fuselage Wiring — Landing Gear Bay Wiring

abstract: Wiring sheet for the landing gear bay harness, showing the brake control unit runs and the bleed valve position sensing pairs that pass through the same bay route.

sections.purpose: To show the landing gear bay harness including the brake control unit runs and the bleed valve position sensing pairs.
sections.sheet_note: Two separate systems share the bay route on this sheet and the segregation between them is the reason it is drawn as one sheet rather than two. The bleed valve position sensing pairs enter the bay from the belly fairing and leave it at the pylon disconnect; they are not part of the gear system and must not be re-routed with the gear harness during a repair. Two spare pairs remain on the left-hand gear run and are shown in the spare count on sheet 1. Sheet 2 shows the clamp positions along the gear leg where chafing has been reported.
sections.routing_note: The main run leaves the brake control unit bay at zone 773 and follows the gear leg down to the axle position, with clamps at the intervals on sheet 2. A second run crosses the bay at zone 771 to the right-hand gear. The bleed position sensing pairs pass through zone 191 on their way from the belly fairing to the pylon disconnect.

ata.title: Centre Fuselage Wiring — Landing Gear Bay Wiring

abstract: Wiring sheet for the landing gear bay harness, showing the brake control unit runs and the bleed valve position sensing pairs, with the clamp separation that has to be restored after any work in the bay.

sections.purpose: To show the landing gear bay harness including the brake control unit runs and the bleed valve position sensing pairs, and the separation between them.
sections.sheet_note: Two separate systems share the bay route on this sheet and the segregation between them is the reason it is drawn as one sheet rather than two. The bleed valve position sensing pairs enter the bay from the belly fairing and leave it at the pylon disconnect; they are not part of the gear system and must not be re-routed with the gear harness during a repair. Two spare pairs remain on the left-hand gear run and are shown in the spare count on sheet 1. Sheet 2 shows the clamp positions along the gear leg where chafing has been reported and now dimensions the separation at each one.
sections.routing_note: The main run leaves the brake control unit bay at zone 773 and follows the gear leg down to the axle position, with clamps at the intervals on sheet 2. A second run crosses the bay at zone 771 to the right-hand gear. The bleed position sensing pairs pass through zone 191 and are separated from the gear runs by at least 50 mm at every clamp; this separation is a certification requirement and must be restored exactly after any work in the bay. It is dimensioned rather than left to the drawing scale because a technician putting the bay back together after an unrelated repair has no other way of knowing that the two runs may not simply be clamped together where it is convenient.

abstract: Wiring sheet for the landing gear bay harness, showing the brake control unit runs, the wheel sensing receiver feeds and the bleed valve position sensing pairs that share the same bay route.

sections.purpose: To show the landing gear bay harness including the brake control unit runs, the wheel pressure sensing receiver feeds and the bleed valve position sensing pairs.
sections.sheet_note: Three separate systems share the bay route on this sheet and the segregation between them is the reason it is drawn as one sheet rather than three. The wheel sensing receiver feeds were added at the tyre pressure indicating standard and occupy the pairs that were previously spare; the spare count shown on sheet 1 has been corrected accordingly and is now zero on the left-hand run. The bleed valve position sensing pairs enter the bay from the belly fairing and leave it at the pylon disconnect; they are not part of the gear system and must not be re-routed with the gear harness during a repair. Sheet 2 shows the clamp positions along the gear leg where chafing has been reported.
sections.routing_note: The main run leaves the brake control unit bay at zone 773 and follows the gear leg to the receiver position, with clamps at the intervals on sheet 2. A second run crosses the bay at zone 771 to the right-hand gear. The bleed position sensing pairs pass through zone 191 and are separated from the gear runs by at least 50 mm at every clamp; this separation is a certification requirement and must be restored exactly after any work in the bay.
